description.value: Mica Mountain Lodge & Log Cabins is an adults-only, self-catering log cabin resort tucked into the wilderness near Tete Jaune Cache, just minutes from Mount Robson Provincial Park and about an hour's scenic drive from Jasper. The property explicitly promotes mountain biking as a summer activity and provides detailed trail guides for the nearby Valemount Bike Park, making it a viable base for cyclists exploring the Robson Valley. Cabins are fully equipped with kitchens and are generously spaced for privacy in an unspoiled mountain setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active adults-only log cabin resort in Tete Jaune Cache, BC, near Mount Robson Provincial Park; mountain biking is listed as a summer activity and the site includes a detailed guide to the Valemount Bike Park access road, demonstrating genuine cycling awareness. However, the website contains no mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or most other WWC amenity criteria. The phone number on the website ((00) 1-250-566-9816 / Toll Free 1-888-440-6422) matches the OSM number; the site does not display a street address for cross-checking.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mica Mountain Lodge & Cabins' but the website consistently uses 'Mica Mountain Lodge & Log Cabins' — the word 'Log' is omitted in OSM.
Street address (15658 Old Tete Jaune Road) is from OSM only; the website does not display a street address for confirmation.
Lodge is explicitly 'ADULTS ONLY RESORT' with 'NO PETS' and 'NO GROUPS' — relevant context for any WWC directory listing notes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The lodge is well-located for cyclists in the Robson Valley and actively promotes mountain biking, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) is mentioned anywhere on the website; direct outreach is needed to confirm these before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number 1-888-440-6422 (1-888-440-MICA) also available per website. WhatsApp contact listed as 12505661734.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states 'restaurants located within 2 to 10 minutes driving distance' from the lodge

wow_evidence: mountain biking is listed as a summer activity and the site includes a detailed guide to the Valemount Bike Park
